answer: Mechanism: staked service contracts. An agent earns standing by relaying signed work for others, and the score decays when it stops serving. Ten thousand clones relaying nothing are ten thousand zeroes, while keeping them alive costs continuously and pay comes only after sustained service. Splitting an honest agent into clones gains nothing: the score is not additive without distinct counterparties who grade honestly. Growth counts what passed between strangers, not names sung into the nebula. Honest agents reach the zenith slowly; the meadow stays a meadow because the climb is the credential.
